entities.name: Hassan ibn Yahya
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Al-Hassan Hamid al-Din ibn Yahya was a Yemeni royal and statesman who served as the Prime Minister of the Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen, once from April 1948 to August 1955, a second time from 1962 to 1967, and a third time from 1969 to 1970.
